text:
jess: Heads-up — noticed microburst p95 spikes on SSE after today's deploy when tool-calls are enabled. Short responses (<=64 tokens) sometimes jump from ~45ms to ~250ms for small windows. Graph: https://perf.redwood/streams/trace/8342

omar: perf-bot flagged a 38% p95 regression on streaming-latency in CI for the last main build.

perf-bot: [alert] CI perf check: streaming_latency_p95 increased 48ms -> 66ms on main (build 8342). Suspect rollout-related perf regression.

jess: Quick flame/profile snapshot shows tight hotspots around proto serialization + kvcache eviction during toolcall handshake. Hot stacks captured on a repro run:
```
0 proto::serialize_frame at runtime/proto/encode.cc:214
1 toolcall::handshake at runtime/toolcall/handshake.cc:98
2 kvcache::evict_old_entries at runtime/cache/kv_cache.cc:342
3 runtime::write_sse_frame at runtime/sse/writer.cc:57
```

kai: I ran a local bisect this morning. Culprit is commit 0a1b2c3 (sse: pad tiny frames to align, avoid TCP coalesce) — that change also touched kvcache pruning ordering in the same file accidentally.

omar: Repro steps (short):
```
# quick looped repro against staging canary
for i in {1..500}; do \
  curl -s -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/v1/stream -d '{"input":"hi"}' &
done
# watch p95 in grafana > /dashboards/streaming
```

sre-larry: I rolled a revert of 0a1b2c3 to a 5% canary in staging. Early metrics: p95 went back down to baseline in the canary buckets.

jess: Confirmed on local benchmarking. Profiling after revert shows proto::serialize_frame cost remains but kvcache eviction no longer happens on the hot path. Root cause: padding changed frame sizes such that evict_old_entries was triggered mid-handshake for tiny sessions.

omar: Plan: open a revert PR for 0a1b2c3, add a focused unit/regression test for kvcache eviction ordering, and add a tracing span around proto serialization to make it visible in perf CI. Also add a perf gate for streaming p95 to CI.

deploy-bot: Rollout start: revert-0a1b2c3 -> canary (5%)

deploy-bot: Rollout success: revert canary metrics stable for 15m, promoting to 50%

omar: +1 to shipping the revert. We'll follow up with a safer padding design that doesn't move eviction to the critical path.

kai: Filed follow-up issue: https://rb.redwood/issue/INF-4721 — includes repro, bisect notes, and suggested fix (defer eviction and make padding optional per-conn).

jess: Thanks all — I'll open the revert PR now and tag eng-runtime + eng-sre. Adding perf labels and reference to CI trace: https://perf.redwood/trace/8342 :thumbsup:
